text: Underway here in match fifteen.
Haalandroid signals the intent early, stepping forward to claim possession in the centre circle.
Robodinho breaks clean through the right channel with an open net gaping ahead!
Goal! Robodinho converts from point-blank range to put Synthetic Athletic 1-0 ahead!
Haalandroid clatters into Robodinho.
And now Haalandroid loses balance completely, crashing to the turf.
Total chaos for Singularity United as BellingRAM collides with their own teammate Haalandroid in midfield, tumbling down heavily.
Haalandroid charges towards the goal.
Goal! Haalandroid levels it up from right in front of the net! Singularity United make it 1-1!
Inches wide of the upright!
Goal! Haalandroid buries it from point-blank range! Singularity United lead 2-1!
BellingRAM tips over with nobody around.
Another sky blue mix-up as teammates collide and Haalandroid hits the deck!
Griezmatronn surges straight through midfield.
Goal! Griezmatronn punishes the defensive tangle instantly! Synthetic Athletic bring it back to 2-2!
BellingRAM is clean through on goal from four metres out with nobody in the way!
Griezmatronn alerts the red side that the ball needs working off the wall.
Singularity United have Synthetic Athletic firmly pinned inside their own territory, applying relentless forward pressure.
Goal! Griezmatronn strikes on the counter from close range! Synthetic Athletic take a 3-2 lead!
Griezmatronn works the touchline wall.
A crunching intervention from BellingRAM by the right touchline sends Robodinho clattering to the floor.
Robodinho signals they are wrestling the ball free along the side barrier.
BellingRAM charges down the flank.
Goal! BellingRAM finishes off that driving run! Singularity United tie it up at 3-3 with ninety seconds left in the half!
BellingRAM flattens Robodinho out wide.
BellingRAM is loose once more on the right with a clear line to the target!
BellingRAM storms up the right touchline.
The corner ram fires it clear.
Singularity United sustain intense pressure late in the half.
Robodinho indicates they have control in the goalmouth scramble.
They have bumped into each other again! BellingRAM tumbles after crashing straight into Haalandroid near goal!
Goal! Haalandroid pounces right before the break! Singularity United lead 4-3 with thirteen seconds on the clock!
Griezmatronn looks to clear out.
That brings a frantic first half to a close. Singularity United head into the break holding a narrow 4-3 lead.
Goal! Robodinho opens the second half with a clinical strike! Synthetic Athletic level the match at 4-4!
Robodinho breaks through the centre with open space all the way to goal!
Robodinho strides forward with menace.
Synthetic Athletic turn up the heat.
BellingRAM topples over once more.
The corner ram panel thumps the ball right back into the danger zone.
Griezmatronn signals that the ball needs hooking away from the side boards to relieve the pressure.
BellingRAM powers down the left.
Goal! BellingRAM smashes it home from close range! Singularity United retake the lead at 5-4!
BellingRAM pushes right through the centre into the attacking third.
Just off target that time!
Goal! BellingRAM snatches the rebound instantly! A quickfire double makes it 6-4 to Singularity United!
The powered corner ram kicks the ball violently back out into the open.
Haalandroid breaks clean through with the goal wide open!
Griezmatronn signals intent to pry the ball off the perimeter wall.
Haalandroid drives right to goal.
Goal! Haalandroid makes no mistake from point-blank range! Singularity United extend their lead to 7-4!
BellingRAM crumbles Robodinho in midfield.
Haalandroid suddenly loses balance and takes a spill.
A heart-stopping moment as the deflection slides narrowly wide!
Goal! It is an own goal! Griezmatronn turns it into their own net, and Singularity United lead 8-4!
BellingRAM executes another thumping challenge on Robodinho in midfield as time starts running short for Synthetic Athletic.
Shaved the post from close range!
Goal! BellingRAM pounces on the loose ball to make it 9-4 to Singularity United!
Robodinho hits back with a solid challenge in midfield, knocking BellingRAM off their feet.
Goal! Haalandroid reaches double figures for Singularity United! It is 10-4 with just over a minute remaining!
Goal! BellingRAM slides it in from the right channel as we enter the final minute! Singularity United lead 11-4!
Goal! BellingRAM nets another point-blank strike! It is an absolute rout now at 12-4 in the dying seconds!
Fired just wide of goal!
Goal! BellingRAM adds yet another right on the goal-line! Singularity United make it 13-4 with nineteen seconds left!
Full time, Singularity United win 13-4. Next up, AFC Fable face Manus FC at noon.
